title: Camp Street from Lafayette Square New Orleans Stereo Blessing
blurb: New Orleans: Stereocard view, 1870s. View looking down Camp Street from Lafayette Square. Original caption: "Views of New Orleans No. 405. CAMP STREET from Lafayette Square to Canal Street, showing John Gauche's new Iron Building, covering an entire block -- the largest Store in New Orleans." The building referred to is better known as the "Moresque Building", seen at left in the photo.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.18% vertical error and 0.07° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (1.84% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
